predeploys.name: WBLCH
predeploys.notes: WETH9-style wrapper for the native gas-BLCH, fixed OP-convention predeploy address per BLOCH-L2-EVM-DESIGN.md section 5. Genesis-alloc'd, never deployed by tx. Source is the crate-local canonical copy at contracts/wblch/WBLCH.sol, byte-identical (same keccak) to the repo-root ../../contracts/wblch/WBLCH.sol that the Foundry invariant tests exercise; the source_keccak256 pin makes any drift between the two loud. Deliberately WETH9-verbatim: NO privileged mint/burn — supply is exactly the native BLCH escrowed, and the bridge/system-gated mint lives at the NATIVE level (BlochDepositTx mints gas-BLCH; L2BlochBridge burns it), per section 5. deployed_bytecode_keccak256 is the REAL keccak-256 of the runtime bytecode solc 0.8.24 emits under the pinned settings (metadata bytecodeHash=none, optimizer runs=200, evmVersion=shanghai); the harness test recompiles and asserts it, failing if WBLCH.sol or the compiler pin drifts. UNAUDITED; inert until the published activation gates clear.

l2_bloch_bridge.name: L2BlochBridge
l2_bloch_bridge.notes: Withdrawal predeploy per section 5: burns native gas-BLCH (or unwraps WBLCH first), appends leaf = keccak256(abi.encode(uint64 nonce, address l2Sender, bytes20 l1Recipient, uint64 amountAtoms, uint64 epochNumber)) to a depth-32 keccak incremental Merkle tree; refuses a zero l1Recipient; the WBLCH path is reentrancy-locked (belt-and-braces over the WBLCH-gated receive()). Leaf is byte-identical to the Rust encoder in src/withdrawal.rs — pinned by contracts/verify_leaf.py (golden leaf 0x0b0f4ac6fd0554ae9b750f72fa2e028753b3985d4faecd52fc2995dd3e3f789a). deployed_bytecode_keccak256 is the REAL keccak-256 of the runtime bytecode solc 0.8.24 emits under the pinned settings (same compiler block as WBLCH); the harness test design_contract_pins_match_on_disk_and_compile recompiles and asserts it whenever the pinned solc is present, and always enforces the source pin.

l1_release_verifier.name: L1ReleaseVerifier
l1_release_verifier.notes: NOT a predeploy and NOT deployable on Bloch L1 (Bloch has no EVM). Reference/design stub for release-checklist item [3]: depth-32 Merkle inclusion vs an OPERATOR-POSTED withdrawals root, with the all-zero unanchored-root refusal mirrored from src/withdrawal.rs; its `released` nullifier is keyed by the withdrawal LEAF (bytes32), mirroring src/release.rs NullifierLog, never by the bare nonce. v1 release is CUSTODIAL, full stop — the operator posts roots; this contract adds zero trustlessness and moves no value. Address null because it has no home chain today; a test-EVM deploy for cross-checking the Rust reference is its only intended use. deployed_bytecode_keccak256 is the REAL keccak-256 of the runtime bytecode solc 0.8.24 emits under the pinned settings (the constructor's immutable `operator` appears as its zero placeholder in runtime bytecode, so the hash is deterministic); enforced by the harness test whenever the pinned solc is present, source pin always.
